title: Final Expression for ε
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the expression for ε in terms of λ.

title: Numerical Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a correct numerical estimate of ε for Earth.

title: Equilibrium Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should clearly state the condition for equilibrium of the planet's surface.

title: Centrifugal Force Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the centrifugal force acting on a mass element.

title: Gravitational Force Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the expression for the gravitational force acting on a mass element.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the equilibrium condition.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors are included in the final expressions.
